annotations.title: How do I watch MSNBC live on the internet? – NBC News Group

content.text:
To watch **MSNBC live online legally**, use the official stream:

**MSNBC Live:** search for **“MSNBC live”** or go to the official MSNBC live page. You’ll usually need to **log in with a supported TV provider** for unlimited live streaming. NBC’s help page says MSNBC is available online but requires a supported TV-provider login. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174697854227-How-do-I-watch-MSNBC-live-on-the-internet?utm_source=openai))

**Free/low-cost legal options:**
- **Free trials** from live-TV streaming services that carry MSNBC, such as **YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, DirecTV Stream, or Sling** — availability and trial lengths change.
- **NBC News NOW** is a free live news alternative, but it is **not the same as MSNBC**.
- MSNBC clips and segments are often available free on MSNBC/NBC News websites, YouTube, and social media.

I’d avoid random “free MSNBC live stream” sites, since they may be unauthorized, unreliable, or unsafe.
